label: TotalEnergyFlowState
info:
Reads Total Energy Flow State from registers:
- 616-619: Battery charge/discharge total (U32, 0.1kWh)
- 622-625: Grid import/export total (U32, 0.1kWh)
- 627-628: Load total (U32, 0.1kWh)
- 634-635: PV total (U32, 0.1kWh)
- 637-638: Generator total (U32, 0.1kWh)

Triggers:
1. Daily at 23:58
2. Manual inject
